entities.name: Ebony Rhino
entities.description: An artifact from the time of the Great War between the Ancients and the Tolgath on Ulgrotha.

entities.name: Eron
entities.description: Recipient of the Ebony Rhino as a bribe, later cheated out of it.

entities.name: Chandler
entities.description: Thief who, with Joven, cheated the rhino away from Eron.

entities.name: Joven
entities.description: Thief who, with Chandler, cheated the rhino away from Eron.

entities.name: Koskun Mountains
entities.description: Mountains where goblins unearthed the rhino.

events.summary: A goblin family unearthed the Ebony Rhino in the Koskun Mountains and used it as a bribe to Eron.
events.quote: It was discovered by a goblin family in the Koskun Mountains

events.summary: Chandler and Joven cheated the Ebony Rhino away from Eron.
events.quote: It was later cheated away from Eron by Chandler and Joven

relations.note: Eron swore a legendary punishment for the thieves.
relations.quote: Eron has sworn that if he ever catches the two thieves
